title: Countdown Beeps
blurb: Three short beeps and one long high tone — the universal countdown. Rocket launches, game starts, ring timers, microwave psychological warfare: this cadence means something is about to happen. Editors use it to build tension before a reveal; streamers run it before a match starts. Synthesized clean at 1 kHz so it cuts through any mix. Free MP3 download.
origin: Original synthesis of the standard 3-short-1-long countdown cadence.
